method: Read-only web tool open of the live primary service form; crawl reported today. Direct Python requests returned 403 and remains recorded separately; no access bypass.
observation: The visible service form identifies GSPS Marine at 3807 Gulf Shores Pkwy, Gulf Shores AL. Vessel Being Serviced contains Make, Model, Year, HIN# and Hours. Describe Service Needs contains requested work and Appointment Date. Prior Service History asks Have We Serviced Your Vessel Before? with Yes/No choices, then Last In and Work Done. No statement that customer history is pre-filled or that a database is queried was observed.
editorialDisposition: Replacement for the held Make Wake draft-source concept. Published guidance is a proposed form-writing check, not an assertion about existing software behavior.
